# Tinker's Tools (`equipment:tinkers-tools`)
**Categories:** [Artisan's Tools](../equipment-categories/artisans-tools.md), [Tools](../equipment-categories/tools.md) | **Cost:** 50 gp | **Weight:** 10 lb.
**Ability:** [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md)

## Utilize
- Assemble a Tiny item composed of scrap, which falls apart in 1 minute (DC 10 [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md))
**Craft:** [Musket](../equipment/musket.md), [Pistol](../equipment/pistol.md), [Bell](../equipment/bell.md), [Lantern, Bullseye](../equipment/lantern-bullseye.md), [Flask](../equipment/flask.md), [Lantern, Hooded](../equipment/lantern-hooded.md), [Hunting Trap](../equipment/hunting-trap.md), [Lock](../equipment/lock.md), [Manacles](../equipment/manacles.md), [Mirror](../equipment/mirror.md), [Shovel](../equipment/shovel.md), [Signal Whistle](../equipment/signal-whistle.md), [Tinderbox](../equipment/tinderbox.md)
